Name: Crab Juice
Author: ichortower
Description:
[size=6][b][u]Crab Juice[/u][/b][/size]

[size=3]This mod adds a trigger to the keg's Default_Juice recipe to allow it to accept crabs as input. As a result, crabs can become juice.[/size]

[size=3]Supports vanilla crabs, and new crabs added by several mods (Stardew Valley Expanded, Passerby Cemetery, More New Fish).[/size]


[size=4][b][u]How to Juice a Crab[/u][/b][/size]

[size=3]The new trigger accepts any item with the context tags "category_fish" and "fish_crab". To support modded crabs, this mod adds the "fish_crab" context tag to the object data for known crab types.[/size]

[size=3]Please let me know of any modded crabs that I missed.[/size]

Manifest.Name: Crab Juice
Manifest.Description: Allows you to make Juice from crabs.
